"""Orchestrates the three agents around the decision engine.

    interpret(idea)            Agent 1 -> IdeaSpec + candidates             (PM confirms / edits)
    evaluate(spec, policy)     DecisionEngine -> FactBundle + evidence subgraph   (no LLM, instant)
    explain(evaluation_id)     Agent 2 writes -> Agent 3 verifies -> one rewrite -> strip what still fails
"""

import threading
import time
from collections import OrderedDict

from .. import config
from ..decision import MARKETS, merge_policy, policy_hash
from ..graph.semantic import SemanticIndex
from ..graph.store import get_graph
from . import explainer, verifier
from .contracts import SECTIONS, Explanation, IdeaSpec, VerificationReport
from .evidence import subgraph
from .facts import build_bundle, evaluation_id
from .llm import LLMUnavailable, from_env, model_config
from .retriever import Retriever

MAX_CACHED = 64


class UnknownEvaluation(LookupError):
    """The evaluation id is not (or no longer) in the cache."""

NO_KEY = ("No OpenAI API key is configured, so the explanation and verification agents cannot run. Set "
          "OPENAI_API_KEY in the environment or in a .env file in the repository root, then try again. The "
          "evidence above comes from the decision engine and does not need the key.")


class Pipeline:
    def __init__(self, engine, llm="env"):
        self.engine = engine
        self.g, self.graph_meta = get_graph()
        self.index = SemanticIndex(self.g)
        self.retriever = Retriever(engine, self.g, self.index)
        self._env_llm = llm == "env"
        self.llm = from_env() if self._env_llm else llm
        self.feature_names = set(engine.ctx.features.index)
        self._evals: OrderedDict = OrderedDict()
        self._candidates: OrderedDict = OrderedDict()
        self._lock = threading.Lock()

    def _current_llm(self):
        """Pick up a key added to the environment or .env after start-up."""
        if self.llm is None and self._env_llm:
            self.llm = from_env()
        return self.llm

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ status
    def status(self, check: bool = False) -> dict:
        llm = self._current_llm()
        out = {"llm_configured": llm is not None, "provider": "openai",
               "models": llm.models if llm else model_config(),
               "graph": {"nodes": self.graph_meta["n_nodes"], "edges": self.graph_meta["n_edges"],
                         "built_at": self.graph_meta["built_at"],
                         "checks_passed": all(c["ok"] for c in self.graph_meta["checks"]),
                         "n_checks": len(self.graph_meta["checks"])},
               "message": None if llm else NO_KEY}
        if llm is not None and check:
            out["availability"] = llm.check_models(refresh=True)
        return out

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ Agent 1
    def interpret(self, idea: str) -> dict:
        res = self.retriever.interpret(idea, self._current_llm())
        with self._lock:
            self._candidates[res.spec.idea] = res.candidates
            while len(self._candidates) > MAX_CACHED:
                self._candidates.popitem(last=False)
        return res.model_dump()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ engine + facts
    def evaluate(self, spec_data: dict, policy: dict | None = None) -> dict:
        spec = IdeaSpec.model_validate(spec_data, context={"allowed_features": self.feature_names})
        models = list(spec.series) or None
        markets = list(spec.markets) or None
        if spec.features:
            result = self.engine.evaluate("", [f.feature for f in spec.features], policy, models, markets)
            result["idea"] = spec.idea
        else:
            pol = merge_policy(policy)
            result = {"idea": spec.idea, "resolution": None, "features": [], "status": "no_direct_evidence",
                      "policy": pol, "policy_hash": policy_hash(pol), "data_hash": self.engine.fingerprint["hash"],
                      "models": models or list(config.MODELS), "markets": markets or list(MARKETS)}
        with self._lock:
            candidates = self._candidates.get(spec.idea)
        if candidates is None:
            candidates = self.retriever.candidates(spec.idea, self._current_llm())[0]
        eid = evaluation_id(spec, result["policy_hash"], result["data_hash"])
        bundle = build_bundle(self.engine, self.g, spec, result, candidates, eid)
        graph = subgraph(self.g, spec, result, bundle, candidates)
        with self._lock:
            prev = self._evals.get(eid)
            self._evals[eid] = {"spec": spec, "result": result, "bundle": bundle,
                                "explained": prev["explained"] if prev else None}
            self._evals.move_to_end(eid)
            while len(self._evals) > MAX_CACHED:
                self._evals.popitem(last=False)
        return {"evaluation_id": eid, "spec": spec.model_dump(), "result": result,
                "facts": [f.model_dump() for f in bundle.facts], "graph": graph,
                "candidates": [c.model_dump() for c in candidates]}

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ Agents 2 + 3
    def explain(self, eid: str, force: bool = False) -> dict:
        with self._lock:
            entry = self._evals.get(eid)
        if entry is None:
            raise UnknownEvaluation(eid)
        if entry["explained"] and not force:
            return entry["explained"]
        llm = self._current_llm()
        if llm is None:
            raise LLMUnavailable(NO_KEY)
        t0 = time.time()
        spec, bundle = entry["spec"], entry["bundle"]
        claims = verifier.verify(explainer.to_claims(explainer.write(llm, bundle, spec), 1), bundle, llm)
        rewritten, attempts = [], 1
        if any(c.status == "removed" for c in claims):
            rewritten = [c for c in claims if c.status == "removed"]
            draft = explainer.write(llm, bundle, spec, feedback=rewritten)
            claims = verifier.verify(explainer.to_claims(draft, 2), bundle, llm)
            attempts = 2
        sections = {s: [c for c in claims if c.section == s and c.status == "verified"] for s in SECTIONS}
        explanation = Explanation(evaluation_id=eid, model=llm.models["explainer"], sections=sections,
                                  attempts=attempts)
        report = VerificationReport(evaluation_id=eid, rules=verifier.RULES, semantic_model=llm.models["verifier"],
                                    claims=claims, rewritten=rewritten,
                                    n_verified=sum(c.status == "verified" for c in claims),
                                    n_removed=sum(c.status == "removed" for c in claims))
        out = {"explanation": explanation.model_dump(), "verification": report.model_dump(),
               "seconds": round(time.time() - t0, 1)}
        entry["explained"] = out
        return out
"""Pydantic contracts between the three agents, the decision engine and the frontend.

Models ending in `LLM` are what a language model is asked to return. They are
kept free of defaults and dict fields so OpenAI's strict structured outputs
accept them. Everything an LLM returns is then re-validated into the strict
models below with the context it must respect (e.g. the allowed feature names).
"""

from typing import Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, ValidationInfo, field_validator, model_validator

Series = Literal["F70", "G60", "G70"]
Market = Literal["EU", "US", "CN", "RoW"]
Move = Literal["fix_existing", "make_standard", "new_option", "price_change", "introduce_on_series", "unspecified"]
Novelty = Literal["matches_existing", "related_only", "new_to_data"]
SERIES: tuple = ("F70", "G60", "G70")
MARKETS: tuple = ("EU", "US", "CN", "RoW")
MAX_FEATURES = 3

MOVE_LABELS = {
    "fix_existing": "Fix or improve what exists",
    "make_standard": "Make it standard equipment",
    "new_option": "Offer it as a new option",
    "price_change": "Change the price",
    "introduce_on_series": "Introduce it on another series",
    "unspecified": "Not specified",
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------- Agent 1: retriever
class Candidate(BaseModel):
    """A feature the code (not the LLM) found for the idea, with how it was found."""
    feature: str
    node_id: str
    domain: str
    verdict: str
    n_comments: int
    umbrella: bool
    methods: dict[str, float]          # e.g. {"alias": 1.0, "classifier": 0.42, "semantic": 0.61}
    how: list[str]                     # human-readable match reasons


class FeaturePickLLM(BaseModel):
    feature: str
    reason: str


class IdeaSpecLLM(BaseModel):
    summary: str
    features: list[FeaturePickLLM]
    series: list[Series]
    markets: list[Market]
    move: Move
    proposed_price_eur: float | None
    novelty: Novelty
    ambiguities: list[str]


class FeaturePick(BaseModel):
    feature: str
    node_id: str
    reason: str
    methods: dict[str, float] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class IdeaSpec(BaseModel):
    """What the idea is about, validated against the knowledge graph. Confirmed or edited by the PM."""
    idea: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=2000)
    summary: str
    features: list[FeaturePick] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=MAX_FEATURES)
    series: list[Series] = Field(default_factory=list)       # empty = all series
    markets: list[Market] = Field(default_factory=list)      # empty = all markets
    move: Move = "unspecified"
    proposed_price_eur: float | None = None
    novelty: Novelty = "matches_existing"
    ambiguities: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    method: str = "rules"

    @field_validator("proposed_price_eur")
    @classmethod
    def _price_positive(cls, v):
        if v is not None and not (0 < v < 1_000_000):
            raise ValueError("proposed_price_eur must be a positive amount in EUR below 1,000,000")
        return v

    @field_validator("series", "markets")
    @classmethod
    def _unique(cls, v):
        if len(set(v)) != len(v):
            raise ValueError("duplicate entries")
        return v

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _graph_consistency(self, info: ValidationInfo):
        allowed = (info.context or {}).get("allowed_features")
        names = [f.feature for f in self.features]
        if len(set(names)) != len(names):
            raise ValueError("a feature is listed twice")
        if allowed is not None:
            unknown = [n for n in names if n not in allowed]
            if unknown:
                raise ValueError(f"features not among the retrieved candidates: {unknown}. "
                                 f"Choose only from: {sorted(allowed)}")
        for f in self.features:
            if f.node_id != f"feature:{f.feature}":
                raise ValueError(f"node_id {f.node_id!r} does not belong to feature {f.feature!r}")
        if self.novelty == "matches_existing" and not self.features:
            raise ValueError("novelty is 'matches_existing' but no feature was chosen")
        if self.novelty == "new_to_data" and self.features:
            raise ValueError("novelty is 'new_to_data' but features were chosen; use 'matches_existing' "
                             "or 'related_only'")
        return self


class InterpretResult(BaseModel):
    spec: IdeaSpec
    candidates: list[Candidate]
    semantic_method: str
    semantic_error: str | None = None
    method: str
    attempts: list[dict]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------- facts (deterministic)
class Provenance(BaseModel):
    node_id: str | None                # knowledge-graph node (or request-time node such as rec:...)
    kind: str                          # table | pdf | xlsx | model | derived | config | engine | pm
    ref: str
    key: str | None = None
    page: int | None = None


class Fact(BaseModel):
    id: str
    group: str
    statement: str
    value: float | int | str | bool | None = None
    unit: str | None = None
    feature: str | None = None
    series: str | None = None
    market: str | None = None
    source: Provenance


class FactBundle(BaseModel):
    evaluation_id: str
    idea: str
    facts: list[Fact]

    def index(self) -> dict:
        return {f.id: f for f in self.facts}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------- Agent 2: explainer
SECTIONS = ["headline", "customer_evidence", "market_view", "price_and_equipment", "risks_and_caveats", "next_steps"]
SECTION_TITLES = {
    "headline": "Bottom line", "customer_evidence": "What customers say", "market_view": "Where it matters",
    "price_and_equipment": "Price and equipment today", "risks_and_caveats": "Risks and limits of the evidence",
    "next_steps": "Recommended next steps",
}


class ClaimLLM(BaseModel):
    text: str
    fact_ids: list[str]


class ExplanationLLM(BaseModel):
    headline: ClaimLLM
    customer_evidence: list[ClaimLLM]
    market_view: list[ClaimLLM]
    price_and_equipment: list[ClaimLLM]
    risks_and_caveats: list[ClaimLLM]
    next_steps: list[ClaimLLM]

    def claims(self) -> list[ClaimLLM]:
        return [self.headline] + [c for s in SECTIONS[1:] for c in getattr(self, s)]


class Check(BaseModel):
    name: str
    passed: bool
    detail: str


class Claim(BaseModel):
    id: str
    section: str
    text: str
    fact_ids: list[str]
    status: Literal["verified", "removed"] = "verified"
    attempt: int = 1
    checks: list[Check] = Field(default_factory=list)


class Explanation(BaseModel):
    evaluation_id: str
    model: str
    sections: dict[str, list[Claim]]       # section -> verified claims only
    attempts: int


class VerificationReport(BaseModel):
    evaluation_id: str
    rules: list[str]
    semantic_model: str | None
    claims: list[Claim]                    # final claims, verified and removed
    rewritten: list[Claim]                 # claims of the first draft that failed and triggered the rewrite
    n_verified: int
    n_removed: int


class JudgmentLLM(BaseModel):
    claim_id: str
    verdict: Literal["supported", "unsupported"]
    reason: str


class JudgmentsLLM(BaseModel):
    judgments: list[JudgmentLLM]

    if isinstance(body, dict) and isinstance(body.get("error"), dict):
        return body["error"].get("message") or str(e)
    return str(e)


def from_env() -> OpenAILLM | None:
    key = setting("OPENAI_API_KEY")
    return OpenAILLM(key) if key else None
"""Orchestrates the three agents around the decision engine.

    interpret(idea)            Agent 1 -> IdeaSpec + candidates             (PM confirms / edits)
    evaluate(spec, policy)     DecisionEngine -> FactBundle + evidence subgraph   (no LLM, instant)
    explain(evaluation_id)     Agent 2 writes -> Agent 3 verifies -> one rewrite -> strip what still fails
"""

import threading
import time
from collections import OrderedDict

from .. import config
from ..decision import MARKETS, merge_policy, policy_hash
from ..graph.semantic import SemanticIndex
from ..graph.store import get_graph
from . import explainer, verifier
from .contracts import SECTIONS, Explanation, IdeaSpec, VerificationReport
from .evidence import subgraph
from .facts import build_bundle, evaluation_id
from .llm import LLMUnavailable, from_env, model_config
from .retriever import Retriever

MAX_CACHED = 64


class UnknownEvaluation(LookupError):
    """The evaluation id is not (or no longer) in the cache."""

NO_KEY = ("No OpenAI API key is configured, so the explanation and verification agents cannot run. Set "
          "OPENAI_API_KEY in the environment or in a .env file in the repository root, then try again. The "
          "evidence above comes from the decision engine and does not need the key.")


class Pipeline:
    def __init__(self, engine, llm="env"):
        self.engine = engine
        self.g, self.graph_meta = get_graph()
        self.index = SemanticIndex(self.g)
        self.retriever = Retriever(engine, self.g, self.index)
        self._env_llm = llm == "env"
        self.llm = from_env() if self._env_llm else llm
        self.feature_names = set(engine.ctx.features.index)
        self._evals: OrderedDict = OrderedDict()
        self._candidates: OrderedDict = OrderedDict()
        self._lock = threading.Lock()

    def _current_llm(self):
        """Pick up a key added to the environment or .env after start-up."""
        if self.llm is None and self._env_llm:
            self.llm = from_env()
        return self.llm

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ status
    def status(self, check: bool = False) -> dict:
        llm = self._current_llm()
        out = {"llm_configured": llm is not None, "provider": "openai",
               "models": llm.models if llm else model_config(),
               "graph": {"nodes": self.graph_meta["n_nodes"], "edges": self.graph_meta["n_edges"],
                         "built_at": self.graph_meta["built_at"],
                         "checks_passed": all(c["ok"] for c in self.graph_meta["checks"]),
                         "n_checks": len(self.graph_meta["checks"])},
               "message": None if llm else NO_KEY}
        if llm is not None and check:
            out["availability"] = llm.check_models(refresh=True)
        return out

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ Agent 1
    def interpret(self, idea: str) -> dict:
        res = self.retriever.interpret(idea, self._current_llm())
        with self._lock:
            self._candidates[res.spec.idea] = res.candidates
            while len(self._candidates) > MAX_CACHED:
                self._candidates.popitem(last=False)
        return res.model_dump()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ engine + facts
    def evaluate(self, spec_data: dict, policy: dict | None = None) -> dict:
        spec = IdeaSpec.model_validate(spec_data, context={"allowed_features": self.feature_names})
        models = list(spec.series) or None
        markets = list(spec.markets) or None
        if spec.features:
            result = self.engine.evaluate("", [f.feature for f in spec.features], policy, models, markets)
            result["idea"] = spec.idea
        else:
            pol = merge_policy(policy)
            result = {"idea": spec.idea, "resolution": None, "features": [], "status": "no_direct_evidence",
                      "policy": pol, "policy_hash": policy_hash(pol), "data_hash": self.engine.fingerprint["hash"],
                      "models": models or list(config.MODELS), "markets": markets or list(MARKETS)}
        with self._lock:
            candidates = self._candidates.get(spec.idea)
        if candidates is None:
            candidates = self.retriever.candidates(spec.idea, self._current_llm())[0]
        eid = evaluation_id(spec, result["policy_hash"], result["data_hash"])
        bundle = build_bundle(self.engine, self.g, spec, result, candidates, eid)
        graph = subgraph(self.g, spec, result, bundle, candidates)
        with self._lock:
            prev = self._evals.get(eid)
            self._evals[eid] = {"spec": spec, "result": result, "bundle": bundle,
                                "explained": prev["explained"] if prev else None}
            self._evals.move_to_end(eid)
            while len(self._evals) > MAX_CACHED:
                self._evals.popitem(last=False)
        return {"evaluation_id": eid, "spec": spec.model_dump(), "result": result,
                "facts": [f.model_dump() for f in bundle.facts], "graph": graph,
                "candidates": [c.model_dump() for c in candidates]}

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ Agents 2 + 3
    def explain(self, eid: str, force: bool = False) -> dict:
        with self._lock:
            entry = self._evals.get(eid)
        if entry is None:
            raise UnknownEvaluation(eid)
        if entry["explained"] and not force:
            return entry["explained"]
        llm = self._current_llm()
        if llm is None:
            raise LLMUnavailable(NO_KEY)
        t0 = time.time()
        spec, bundle = entry["spec"], entry["bundle"]
        claims = verifier.verify(explainer.to_claims(explainer.write(llm, bundle, spec), 1), bundle, llm)
        rewritten, attempts = [], 1
        if any(c.status == "removed" for c in claims):
            rewritten = [c for c in claims if c.status == "removed"]
            draft = explainer.write(llm, bundle, spec, feedback=rewritten)
            claims = verifier.verify(explainer.to_claims(draft, 2), bundle, llm)
            attempts = 2
        sections = {s: [c for c in claims if c.section == s and c.status == "verified"] for s in SECTIONS}
        explanation = Explanation(evaluation_id=eid, model=llm.models["explainer"], sections=sections,
                                  attempts=attempts)
        report = VerificationReport(evaluation_id=eid, rules=verifier.RULES, semantic_model=llm.models["verifier"],
                                    claims=claims, rewritten=rewritten,
                                    n_verified=sum(c.status == "verified" for c in claims),
                                    n_removed=sum(c.status == "removed" for c in claims))
        out = {"explanation": explanation.model_dump(), "verification": report.model_dump(),
               "seconds": round(time.time() - t0, 1)}
        entry["explained"] = out
        return out
"""Pydantic contracts between the three agents, the decision engine and the frontend.

Models ending in `LLM` are what a language model is asked to return. They are
kept free of defaults and dict fields so OpenAI's strict structured outputs
accept them. Everything an LLM returns is then re-validated into the strict
models below with the context it must respect (e.g. the allowed feature names).
"""

from typing import Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, ValidationInfo, field_validator, model_validator

Series = Literal["F70", "G60", "G70"]
Market = Literal["EU", "US", "CN", "RoW"]
Move = Literal["fix_existing", "make_standard", "new_option", "price_change", "introduce_on_series", "unspecified"]
Novelty = Literal["matches_existing", "related_only", "new_to_data"]
SERIES: tuple = ("F70", "G60", "G70")
MARKETS: tuple = ("EU", "US", "CN", "RoW")
MAX_FEATURES = 3

MOVE_LABELS = {
    "fix_existing": "Fix or improve what exists",
    "make_standard": "Make it standard equipment",
    "new_option": "Offer it as a new option",
    "price_change": "Change the price",
    "introduce_on_series": "Introduce it on another series",
    "unspecified": "Not specified",
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------- Agent 1: retriever
class Candidate(BaseModel):
    """A feature the code (not the LLM) found for the idea, with how it was found."""
    feature: str
    node_id: str
    domain: str
    verdict: str
    n_comments: int
    umbrella: bool
    methods: dict[str, float]          # e.g. {"alias": 1.0, "classifier": 0.42, "semantic": 0.61}
    how: list[str]                     # human-readable match reasons


class FeaturePickLLM(BaseModel):
    feature: str
    reason: str


class IdeaSpecLLM(BaseModel):
    summary: str
    features: list[FeaturePickLLM]
    series: list[Series]
    markets: list[Market]
    move: Move
    proposed_price_eur: float | None
    novelty: Novelty
    ambiguities: list[str]


class FeaturePick(BaseModel):
    feature: str
    node_id: str
    reason: str
    methods: dict[str, float] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class IdeaSpec(BaseModel):
    """What the idea is about, validated against the knowledge graph. Confirmed or edited by the PM."""
    idea: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=2000)
    summary: str
    features: list[FeaturePick] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=MAX_FEATURES)
    series: list[Series] = Field(default_factory=list)       # empty = all series
    markets: list[Market] = Field(default_factory=list)      # empty = all markets
    move: Move = "unspecified"
    proposed_price_eur: float | None = None
    novelty: Novelty = "matches_existing"
    ambiguities: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    method: str = "rules"

    @field_validator("proposed_price_eur")
    @classmethod
    def _price_positive(cls, v):
        if v is not None and not (0 < v < 1_000_000):
            raise ValueError("proposed_price_eur must be a positive amount in EUR below 1,000,000")
        return v

    @field_validator("series", "markets")
    @classmethod
    def _unique(cls, v):
        if len(set(v)) != len(v):
            raise ValueError("duplicate entries")
        return v

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _graph_consistency(self, info: ValidationInfo):
        allowed = (info.context or {}).get("allowed_features")
        names = [f.feature for f in self.features]
        if len(set(names)) != len(names):
            raise ValueError("a feature is listed twice")
        if allowed is not None:
            unknown = [n for n in names if n not in allowed]
            if unknown:
                raise ValueError(f"features not among the retrieved candidates: {unknown}. "
                                 f"Choose only from: {sorted(allowed)}")
        for f in self.features:
            if f.node_id != f"feature:{f.feature}":
                raise ValueError(f"node_id {f.node_id!r} does not belong to feature {f.feature!r}")
        if self.novelty == "matches_existing" and not self.features:
            raise ValueError("novelty is 'matches_existing' but no feature was chosen")
        if self.novelty == "new_to_data" and self.features:
            raise ValueError("novelty is 'new_to_data' but features were chosen; use 'matches_existing' "
                             "or 'related_only'")
        return self


class InterpretResult(BaseModel):
    spec: IdeaSpec
    candidates: list[Candidate]
    semantic_method: str
    semantic_error: str | None = None
    method: str
    attempts: list[dict]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------- facts (deterministic)
class Provenance(BaseModel):
    node_id: str | None                # knowledge-graph node (or request-time node such as rec:...)
    kind: str                          # table | pdf | xlsx | model | derived | config | engine | pm
    ref: str
    key: str | None = None
    page: int | None = None


class Fact(BaseModel):
    id: str
    group: str
    statement: str
    value: float | int | str | bool | None = None
    unit: str | None = None
    feature: str | None = None
    series: str | None = None
    market: str | None = None
    source: Provenance


class FactBundle(BaseModel):
    evaluation_id: str
    idea: str
    facts: list[Fact]

    def index(self) -> dict:
        return {f.id: f for f in self.facts}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------- Agent 2: explainer
SECTIONS = ["headline", "customer_evidence", "market_view", "price_and_equipment", "risks_and_caveats", "next_steps"]
SECTION_TITLES = {
    "headline": "Bottom line", "customer_evidence": "What customers say", "market_view": "Where it matters",
    "price_and_equipment": "Price and equipment today", "risks_and_caveats": "Risks and limits of the evidence",
    "next_steps": "Recommended next steps",
}


class ClaimLLM(BaseModel):
    text: str
    fact_ids: list[str]


class ExplanationLLM(BaseModel):
    headline: ClaimLLM
    customer_evidence: list[ClaimLLM]
    market_view: list[ClaimLLM]
    price_and_equipment: list[ClaimLLM]
    risks_and_caveats: list[ClaimLLM]
    next_steps: list[ClaimLLM]

    def claims(self) -> list[ClaimLLM]:
        return [self.headline] + [c for s in SECTIONS[1:] for c in getattr(self, s)]


class Check(BaseModel):
    name: str
    passed: bool
    detail: str


class Claim(BaseModel):
    id: str
    section: str
    text: str
    fact_ids: list[str]
    status: Literal["verified", "removed"] = "verified"
    attempt: int = 1
    checks: list[Check] = Field(default_factory=list)


class Explanation(BaseModel):
    evaluation_id: str
    model: str
    sections: dict[str, list[Claim]]       # section -> verified claims only
    attempts: int


class VerificationReport(BaseModel):
    evaluation_id: str
    rules: list[str]
    semantic_model: str | None
    claims: list[Claim]                    # final claims, verified and removed
    rewritten: list[Claim]                 # claims of the first draft that failed and triggered the rewrite
    n_verified: int
    n_removed: int


class JudgmentLLM(BaseModel):
    claim_id: str
    verdict: Literal["supported", "unsupported"]
    reason: str


class JudgmentsLLM(BaseModel):
    judgments: list[JudgmentLLM]

"""Paths and constants shared by the whole pipeline.

All paths resolve from the repository root so the pipeline runs on any machine.
"""

from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent

RAW_DIR = ROOT / "BMW-Data"
PROCESSED_DIR = ROOT / "data" / "processed"
MODELS_DIR = ROOT / "models"
REPORTS_DIR = ROOT / "reports"
FIGURES_DIR = REPORTS_DIR / "figures"

MODELS = ["F70", "G60", "G70"]
MODEL_NAMES = {"F70": "1 Series (F70)", "G60": "5 Series (G60)", "G68": "5 Series LWB (G68)", "G70": "7 Series (G70)"}

FEEDBACK_FILES = {m: RAW_DIR / f"{m}_feedback_hackathon.xlsx" for m in MODELS}
OPTION_LIST_FILES = {m: RAW_DIR / f"{m}_OptionList.PDF" for m in MODELS}
SURVEY_FILE = RAW_DIR / "F70_G60_G68_G70_customer_studies.xlsx"
SALES_FILE = RAW_DIR / "sales_volumes.xlsx"

# Raw column name -> pipeline column name
FEEDBACK_COLUMNS = {
    "ID": "comment_id",
    "Source": "source",
    "Brand": "brand",
    "Sales Description": "sales_description",
    "Country": "country",
    "Derivate (e-code)": "model",
    "Engine Type": "engine",
    "Feedback Type": "feedback_type",
    "Customer Feedback": "text_raw",
    "Vfc level2 3 Name": "vfc_l2_l3",
    "Vfc level2 Name": "feature",
    "Vfc level3 Name": "reason",
}

ENGINE_NAMES = {"ICE": "ICE", "BEVE": "BEV", "PHEV": "PHEV"}

# Feedback Type -> sentiment class used by the verdict
SENTIMENT = {
    "Likes": "positive",
    "Defect": "negative",
    "Difficult to Use": "negative",
    "Wants": "request",
}
FEEDBACK_TYPES = ["Defect", "Difficult to Use", "Wants", "Likes"]

# Labels that say nothing about a specific feature; excluded from verdicts
NON_FEATURE_LABELS = {"no_class_found", "General enquiry: customer feedback"}

# Country -> sales market (sales_volumes.xlsx uses EU / CN / US / RoW)
COUNTRY_TO_MARKET = {
    "US": "US",
    "GB": "EU", "FR": "EU", "SE": "EU", "DK": "EU", "FI": "EU", "NO": "EU", "ES": "EU", "LV": "EU",
    "JP": "RoW", "KR": "RoW", "AU": "RoW", "CA": "RoW", "ZA": "RoW",
}

# Verdict thresholds (see scoring.py)
MIN_MENTIONS_FOR_VERDICT = 8       # below this the feature is "cold start" -> domain prior only
PRIOR_STRENGTH = 5.0               # pseudo-count pulling small features toward their domain
BAD_INDEX = 1.25                   # complaint index at/above which a feature is "Bad" (CI must exclude 1)
GOOD_NEG_INDEX = 0.8               # complaint index at/below which a feature is "Good" (CI must exclude 1)
LEAN_BAD_INDEX = 1.15              # point estimate only -> "Leaning bad"
LEAN_GOOD_NEG_INDEX = 0.87         # point estimate only -> "Leaning good" (1/1.15)
REQUEST_INDEX = 1.5                # request index above which a feature is an unmet need
RANDOM_STATE = 42
"""Command line entry point: python -m bmw_feedback <command>

    build     raw Excel/PDF -> data/processed/*.csv, reports/data_quality.json, scorecards
    train     evaluate + fit text classifiers -> reports/classifier_metrics.json, models/
    figures   regenerate reports/figures/*.png
    export    JSON row files for the interactive dashboard -> data/processed/dashboard/
    graph     knowledge graph of the processed data and model outputs -> data/processed/knowledge_graph.json
    agent     run the three-agent idea evaluation in the terminal (needs OPENAI_API_KEY for agents 2 and 3)
    verdict   PM verdict for a feature (--feature) or a new comment (--text)
    serve     API + web app (Product Decision Studio) on http://127.0.0.1:8000
    all       build + train + graph + figures
"""

import argparse
import json
import sys

import pandas as pd

from . import clean, config, load, scoring, taxonomy


def _save_list_columns(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    out = df.copy()
    for col in ["feedback_types", "sentiments", "domains", "features"]:
        out[col] = out[col].apply("|".join)
    return out


def cmd_build(_args=None) -> None:
    config.PROCESSED_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    config.REPORTS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    print("Loading raw feedback ...")
    raw = load.load_feedback()
    labels, comments, quality = clean.build_tables(raw)
    labels.to_csv(config.PROCESSED_DIR / "labels.csv", index=False)
    _save_list_columns(comments).to_csv(config.PROCESSED_DIR / "comments.csv", index=False)
    print(f"  {len(labels):,} label rows, {len(comments):,} comments "
          f"({quality['comments_by_label_status']})")

    print("Loading survey, sales ...")
    sales = load.load_sales()
    sales.to_csv(config.PROCESSED_DIR / "sales.csv", index=False)
    weights = clean.market_weights(labels, sales)
    weights.to_csv(config.REPORTS_DIR / "market_representativeness.csv", index=False)
    load.load_survey_cn_eu().to_csv(config.PROCESSED_DIR / "survey_cn_eu.csv", index=False)
    survey_us = load.load_survey_us()
    survey_us.to_csv(config.PROCESSED_DIR / "survey_us.csv", index=False)
    load.summarise_survey_us(survey_us).to_csv(config.PROCESSED_DIR / "survey_us_summary.csv", index=False)

    print("Parsing option-list PDFs ...")
    from . import option_catalog
    cat = option_catalog.build_catalog()
    quality["option_catalog"] = option_catalog.validate(cat)
    links = option_catalog.match_features(cat)
    fitment = option_catalog.feature_fitment(links, cat)
    tables = {**cat, "feature_option_links": links, "feature_fitment": fitment,
              "feature_fitment_summary": option_catalog.fitment_summary(fitment),
              "feature_fitment_by_engine": option_catalog.fitment_summary(fitment, ("feature", "model", "engine")),
              "feature_specs": option_catalog.spec_context(cat)}
    for name, frame in tables.items():
        frame.to_csv(config.PROCESSED_DIR / f"catalog_{name}.csv", index=False)
    q = quality["option_catalog"]
    print(f"  {len(cat['variants'])} variants, {len(cat['option_items'])} items, {len(cat['fitment'])} fitment cells, "
          f"{len(cat['technical'])} technical values; {links['feature'].nunique()} feedback features linked")
    print(f"  checks passed: {q['glyphs_assigned']} glyphs assigned, {q['option_price_pairs_checked']} price pairs, "
          f"{q['base_prices_checked']} base prices; {len(q['source_price_anomalies'])} source anomaly")

    print("Scoring features ...")
    feats = scoring.score(labels)
    feats.to_csv(config.REPORTS_DIR / "feature_scorecard.csv", index=False)
    scoring.score(labels, group_keys=("domain",), prior_keys=()).to_csv(
        config.REPORTS_DIR / "domain_scorecard.csv", index=False)
    scoring.score(labels, group_keys=("domain", "model"), prior_keys=()).to_csv(
        config.REPORTS_DIR / "domain_by_model_scorecard.csv", index=False)
    scoring.score(labels, group_keys=("feature", "model")).to_csv(
        config.PROCESSED_DIR / "feature_by_model_scorecard.csv", index=False)
    units = scoring.feature_units(labels)
    specific = units[~units["feature"].isin(taxonomy.UMBRELLA_FEATURES)]
    quality["source_baselines_all_features"] = scoring.source_baselines(units).round(3).to_dict("index")
    quality["source_baselines_specific_features"] = scoring.source_baselines(specific).round(3).to_dict("index")
    quality["verdicts_specific_features"] = feats.loc[~feats["is_umbrella"], "verdict"].value_counts().to_dict()
    (config.REPORTS_DIR / "data_quality.json").write_text(json.dumps(quality, indent=2, default=str))
    print(f"  verdicts (specific features): {quality['verdicts_specific_features']}")


def cmd_train(_args=None) -> None:
    from . import classifier
    from .verdict import load_context
    ctx = load_context()
    print("Cross-validating classifiers ...")
    metrics = classifier.evaluate_all(ctx.comments)
    print("Fitting final models ...")
    classifier.fit_and_save(ctx.comments)
    pool = ctx.comments[ctx.comments["label_status"] != "labeled"]
    preds = classifier.predict(pool["text"].tolist())
    out = pool[["comment_id", "source", "model", "label_status", "text"]].copy()
    out["pred_feedback_types"] = ["|".join(f for f, _ in p["feedback_type"]) for p in preds]
    out["pred_domains"] = ["|".join(d for d, _ in p["domain"]) for p in preds]
    out["pred_top_feature"] = [p["feature"][0][0] for p in preds]
    out["pred_top_feature_p"] = [p["feature"][0][1] for p in preds]
    out.to_csv(config.PROCESSED_DIR / "unlabeled_predictions.csv", index=False)
    metrics["unlabeled_pool"] = {
        "n": int(len(out)),
        "pred_feedback_type_counts": out["pred_feedback_types"].str.split("|").explode().value_counts().to_dict(),
        "pred_domain_counts": out["pred_domains"].str.split("|").explode().value_counts().to_dict(),
    }
    classifier.save_metrics(metrics, config.REPORTS_DIR / "classifier_metrics.json")
    print(f"  saved models to {config.MODELS_DIR.relative_to(config.ROOT)}/ and metrics to reports/")

    print("Option-list ablations ...")
    from . import risk_model
    p = config.PROCESSED_DIR
    fit_by_engine = pd.read_csv(p / "catalog_feature_fitment_by_engine.csv")
    variants = pd.read_csv(p / "catalog_variants.csv")
    fitment = pd.read_csv(p / "catalog_fitment.csv")
    covered = set(map(tuple, fitment[["model", "variant"]].drop_duplicates()
                      .merge(variants[["model", "variant", "engine"]])[["model", "engine"]].drop_duplicates().values))
    units = risk_model.unit_frame(ctx.labels, fit_by_engine, variants, fitment)
    ablation = {
        "complaint_risk_ebm": risk_model.evaluate(units),
        "poor_value_check": risk_model.value_check(units, ctx.labels),
        "feature_classifier_fitment": classifier.fitment_ablation(ctx.comments, fit_by_engine, covered),
    }
    risk_model.fit_and_save(units)
    classifier.save_reranker(ablation["feature_classifier_fitment"], ctx.comments)
    ablation["complaint_risk_ebm"]["production_inputs"] = risk_model.CONTEXT
    ablation["complaint_risk_ebm"]["audit_only_inputs"] = risk_model.CONTEXT + risk_model.PDF
    ablation["complaint_risk_ebm"]["global_production"] = risk_model.global_explanation(risk_model.load())
    ablation["complaint_risk_ebm"]["global_audit_with_pdf"] = risk_model.global_explanation(risk_model.load(audit=True))
    (config.REPORTS_DIR / "model_ablation.json").write_text(json.dumps(ablation, indent=2, default=str))
    e = ablation["complaint_risk_ebm"]
    for k in ("all_features", "linked_features_only"):
        v = e[k]["variants"]
        print(f"  complaint EBM ({k}): AUC context {v['context_only']['auc_mean']:.3f} -> +PDF "
              f"{v['context_plus_pdf']['auc_mean']:.3f} (gain {e[k]['pdf_auc_gain_mean']:+.4f})")

"""Agent 2 - Explainer: fact bundle -> a decision brief for a BMW product manager.

The model (OPENAI_EXPLAINER_MODEL) sees only the facts (ID | deterministic
sentence) and the PM's confirmed scope. Every claim it writes must cite fact
IDs; the verifier then checks each claim against those facts.
"""

from .contracts import SECTIONS, Claim, ExplanationLLM, FactBundle, IdeaSpec, MOVE_LABELS
from .facts import fact_lines
from .llm import LLMOutputInvalid

INSTRUCTIONS = """You are the explanation agent of BMW's product-idea evaluator. Your reader is a BMW product manager deciding whether and where to pursue an idea for the 1 Series (F70), 5 Series (G60) and 7 Series (G70).

You receive FACTS, one per line as "ID | statement". They come from processed customer feedback, the 2025 customer studies, sales volumes, the German price lists and the outputs of trained models. They are your only source of truth.

Write a decision brief:
- headline: one sentence with the bottom line - where the idea is worth pursuing, where not, or that the evidence is insufficient.
- customer_evidence: 2-4 claims on what customers say (verdicts, complaint / request indices, top reasons; a short verbatim quote if it helps).
- market_view: 2-4 claims on where it matters by series and market (recommendations, scores, sales volumes, survey ranks).
- price_and_equipment: 1-3 claims on today's fitment and price and what the proposed move implies.
- risks_and_caveats: 1-3 claims on the limits of the evidence (thin or borrowed data, missing markets, caveats).
- next_steps: 1-3 concrete actions the facts motivate.

Rules - a verifier checks every claim and deletes those that break them:
1. Each claim lists in fact_ids every fact whose number, label, quote, series or market it uses.
2. Use only numbers written in the cited facts, at the same or fewer decimals. Never add, subtract, average, convert or count yourself; if you need a count, difference or share, cite the fact that states it.
3. Write recommendation and verdict labels in single quotes exactly as the facts do, e.g. 'Prioritise', 'Leaning bad'.
4. Put a customer's words in double quotes only when copied exactly from a cited comment fact.
5. Name a series or market only when a cited fact is about it. Write '1 Series (F70)', '5 Series (G60)', '7 Series (G70)', 'Europe', 'United States', 'China', 'Rest of world'.
6. No causes, forecasts, competitors or general knowledge the facts do not state. If evidence is thin or missing, say so plainly.
7. Short, direct sentences for a busy manager. No filler, no marketing language. One idea per claim."""


def _scope(spec: IdeaSpec) -> str:
    feats = ", ".join(f.feature for f in spec.features) or "none (no matching feature in the data)"
    return (f"IDEA: {spec.idea}\nPM-CONFIRMED SCOPE: features {feats}; series {', '.join(spec.series) or 'all'}; "
            f"markets {', '.join(spec.markets) or 'all'}; move {MOVE_LABELS[spec.move]}; proposed price "
            f"{'EUR ' + format(spec.proposed_price_eur, ',.0f') if spec.proposed_price_eur else 'none'}.")


def write(llm, bundle: FactBundle, spec: IdeaSpec, feedback: list[Claim] | None = None) -> ExplanationLLM:
    text = f"{_scope(spec)}\n\nFACTS (ID | statement):\n{fact_lines(bundle)}"
    if feedback:
        lines = []
        for c in feedback:
            failed = "; ".join(f"{ch.name}: {ch.detail}" for ch in c.checks if not ch.passed)
            lines.append(f"- [{c.section}] \"{c.text}\" (cited {', '.join(c.fact_ids) or 'nothing'}) -> {failed}")
        text += ("\n\nYOUR PREVIOUS DRAFT FAILED VERIFICATION FOR THESE CLAIMS. Rewrite the whole brief. Fix each claim "
                 "so that it follows the rules, or drop it:\n" + "\n".join(lines))
    draft = llm.parse("explainer", INSTRUCTIONS, text, ExplanationLLM)
    if not draft.headline.text.strip():
        raise LLMOutputInvalid("The explainer returned an empty headline.", ["headline.text: empty"])
    return draft


def to_claims(draft: ExplanationLLM, attempt: int) -> list[Claim]:
    claims, n = [], 0
    for section in SECTIONS:
        items = [draft.headline] if section == "headline" else getattr(draft, section)
        for c in items:
            if not c.text.strip():          # an empty claim says nothing; drop it rather than verify it
                continue
            n += 1
            ids = list(dict.fromkeys(i.strip() for i in c.fact_ids if i.strip()))
            claims.append(Claim(id=f"c{n}", section=section, text=c.text.strip(), fact_ids=ids, attempt=attempt))
    return claims
"""Agent 3 - Verifier: is every claim backed by the processed data and the model outputs?

Rules run first and need no LLM:
    citations   the claim cites at least one fact, and every cited ID exists in the bundle
    numbers     every number in the claim equals a value in a cited fact at the precision written
                (shares may be written as percentages; signs are checked by the semantic step)
    labels      recommendation / verdict labels in the claim appear in a cited fact
    quotes      text in double quotes (4+ words) is copied from a cited customer comment
    scope       every series and market the claim names is covered by a cited fact
Then an LLM (OPENAI_VERIFIER_MODEL) judges whether the cited facts entail each
claim that passed the rules - the part rules cannot see (direction, causality,
comparisons, words like 'most'). A claim must pass everything to be shown.
"""

import re

from .contracts import Check, Claim, FactBundle, JudgmentsLLM

RULES = ["citations", "numbers", "labels", "quotes", "scope", "semantic"]

LABELS = ["Prioritise", "Consider", "Low priority", "Insufficient evidence", "Not sold", "Bad", "Leaning bad",
          "Mixed", "Leaning good", "Good", "Not enough data"]
UNQUOTED_LABELS = ["Low priority", "Insufficient evidence", "Not sold", "Leaning bad", "Leaning good",
                   "Not enough data"]
SERIES_RX = {"F70": r"\bF70\b|\b1 Series\b|\b1er\b", "G60": r"\bG60\b|\b5 Series\b|\b5er\b",
             "G70": r"\bG70\b|\b7 Series\b|\b7er\b"}
MARKET_RX = {"EU": r"\bEurope(?:an)?\b|\bEU\b", "US": r"\bUnited States\b|\bUS\b|\bU\.S\.|\bAmerican?\b",
             "CN": r"\bChina\b|\bChinese\b|\bCN\b", "RoW": r"\bRest of (?:the )?world\b|\bRoW\b"}
# Phrases whose digits are names, not data
STRIP = [r"\b[A-Z]\d{2}-\d{3,5}\b",                      # comment IDs such as F70-0002 (before series codes)
         r"\b[157](?:\s*(?:,|and|&|/|or)\s*[157])*\s?Series\b",      # '5 Series', '5 and 7 Series', '1, 5 and 7 Series'
         r"\b(?:F70|G60|G68|G70|i5|i7|M60|M70)\b", r"95\s?%\s?(?:CI|confidence)",
         r"\btop[- ]?[23](?:[- ]box)?\b", r"\bbottom[- ]?3(?:[- ]box)?\b", r"\b\d+-fold\b", r"\bSA\s?\w+\b"]
NUM_RE = re.compile(r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9_.,/])(?P<sign>[-−+])?(?:(?:EUR|€)\s?)?"
                    r"(?P<num>\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})+(?:\.\d+)?|\d+(?:\.\d+)?)"
                    r"(?:\s?(?P<scale>thousand|million|billion|bn|mn|k|K|m|M|x|×))?"
                    r"(?P<pct>\s?%|\s?percent\b|\s?pp\b)?(?![A-Za-z0-9]|-[A-Za-z]|[.,]\d)")
SCALE = {"k": 1e3, "K": 1e3, "thousand": 1e3, "m": 1e6, "M": 1e6, "mn": 1e6, "million": 1e6, "bn": 1e9,
         "billion": 1e9, "x": 1.0, "×": 1.0}
DQUOTE_RE = re.compile(r"[\"“]([^\"“”]+)[\"”]")

JUDGE_INSTRUCTIONS = """You are the verification agent of BMW's product-idea evaluator.
For each claim, decide whether its cited facts fully support it. Judge only against the cited facts, never your own knowledge.
- 'supported': everything the claim states follows from the cited facts. Paraphrase and rounding are fine. A recommended next step is supported when the cited facts motivate it and it asserts no new data.
- 'unsupported': the claim adds or changes a number, label, direction (more/fewer, higher/lower), comparison, cause, trend, market, series or quote that the cited facts do not state, or it contradicts them.
Return exactly one judgment per claim_id with a one-sentence reason."""


def numbers_in(text: str) -> list[tuple[float, float, bool]]:
    """(value, tolerance, is_percent) for every data number in the text.

    The tolerance is half a unit of the last digit written, scaled by a k / m / bn suffix, so '0.7' matches
    0.71 and '115k' matches 115,000 but '3.9k' does not match 3,800."""
    for pattern in STRIP:
        text = re.sub(pattern, " ", text)
    out = []
    for m in NUM_RE.finditer(text):
        raw = m.group("num").replace(",", "")
        dec = len(raw.split(".")[1]) if "." in raw else 0
        scale = SCALE.get(m.group("scale") or "", 1.0)
        out.append((float(raw) * scale, 0.5 * 10 ** -dec * scale, bool(m.group("pct"))))
    return out


def _allowed(facts) -> list[tuple[float, bool]]:
    vals = []
    for f in facts:
        if isinstance(f.value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(f.value, bool):
            vals.append((float(f.value), f.unit == "share"))
        vals.extend((v, pct) for v, _, pct in numbers_in(f.statement))
    return vals


def _number_ok(n: float, tol: float, pct: bool, allowed) -> bool:
    for v, _ in allowed:
        cands = [abs(v)]
        if pct:
            cands.append(abs(v) * 100)
        if any(abs(c - abs(n)) <= tol + 1e-9 for c in cands):
            return True
    return False


def _norm(s: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s.lower()).strip(" .,;:!?…'\"“”")


def rule_checks(claim: Claim, index: dict) -> list[Check]:
    checks = []
    unknown = [i for i in claim.fact_ids if i not in index]
    cited = [index[i] for i in claim.fact_ids if i in index]
    if not claim.fact_ids:
        checks.append(Check(name="citations", passed=False, detail="The claim cites no fact."))
    elif unknown:
        checks.append(Check(name="citations", passed=False, detail=f"Unknown fact IDs: {', '.join(unknown)}."))
    else:
        checks.append(Check(name="citations", passed=True, detail=f"{len(cited)} fact(s) cited."))

    allowed = _allowed(cited)
    nums = numbers_in(claim.text)
    bad = [n for n in nums if not _number_ok(n[0], n[1], n[2], allowed)]
    if bad:
        shown = ", ".join(f"{v:,.10g}{'%' if p else ''}" for v, _, p in bad)
        checks.append(Check(name="numbers", passed=False, detail=f"Not found in the cited facts: {shown}."))
    else:
        checks.append(Check(name="numbers", passed=True,
                            detail=f"{len(nums)} number(s) match cited values." if nums else "No numbers."))

    cited_text = " ".join(f.statement for f in cited) + " " + " ".join(str(f.value) for f in cited)
    used = set()
    for label in LABELS:
        if re.search(rf"['‘\"“]{re.escape(label)}['’\"”]", claim.text, re.I):
            used.add(label)
    for label in UNQUOTED_LABELS:
        if re.search(rf"\b{re.escape(label)}\b", claim.text):
            used.add(label)
    values = {str(f.value).lower() for f in cited}
    missing = [lb for lb in sorted(used) if lb.lower() not in values
               and not re.search(rf"['‘]{re.escape(lb)}['’]", " ".join(f.statement for f in cited), re.I)]
    checks.append(Check(name="labels", passed=not missing,
                        detail=(f"Label(s) not in the cited facts: {', '.join(missing)}." if missing else
                                f"{len(used)} label(s) match." if used else "No labels.")))

    sources = [str(f.value) for f in cited if f.group == "quote"] + [f.statement for f in cited]
    norm_sources = [_norm(s) for s in sources]
    bad_quotes = []
    for q in DQUOTE_RE.findall(claim.text):
        if len(q.split()) < 4:
            continue
        parts = [_norm(p) for p in re.split(r"…|\.\.\.", q) if _norm(p)]
        if not all(any(p in s for s in norm_sources) for p in parts):
            bad_quotes.append(q[:60])
    checks.append(Check(name="quotes", passed=not bad_quotes,
                        detail=(f"Not copied from a cited comment: “{bad_quotes[0]}”." if bad_quotes else
                                "Quotes match cited comments." if DQUOTE_RE.search(claim.text) else "No quotes.")))

    scope_missing = []
    for code, rx in SERIES_RX.items():
        if re.search(rx, claim.text) and not (any(f.series == code for f in cited) or re.search(rx, cited_text)):
            scope_missing.append(code)
    for code, rx in MARKET_RX.items():
        if re.search(rx, claim.text) and not (any(f.market == code for f in cited) or re.search(rx, cited_text)):
            scope_missing.append(code)
    checks.append(Check(name="scope", passed=not scope_missing,
                        detail=(f"Names {', '.join(scope_missing)} but no cited fact covers it." if scope_missing
                                else "Series and markets match the cited facts.")))
    return checks


def verify(claims: list[Claim], bundle: FactBundle, llm=None) -> list[Claim]:
    """Run the rules, then the semantic judge on what passed. Returns claims with checks and status set."""
    index = bundle.index()
    for c in claims:
        c.checks = rule_checks(c, index)
    passing = [c for c in claims if all(ch.passed for ch in c.checks)]
    if llm is not None and passing:
        blocks = []
        for c in passing:
            facts = "\n".join(f"    {i}: {index[i].statement}" for i in c.fact_ids)
            blocks.append(f"claim_id: {c.id}\nclaim: {c.text}\ncited facts:\n{facts}")
        result = llm.parse("verifier", JUDGE_INSTRUCTIONS, "\n\n".join(blocks), JudgmentsLLM)
        by_id = {j.claim_id: j for j in result.judgments}
        for c in passing:
            j = by_id.get(c.id)
            if j is None:
                c.checks.append(Check(name="semantic", passed=False, detail="The verifier returned no judgment."))
            else:
                c.checks.append(Check(name="semantic", passed=j.verdict == "supported", detail=j.reason))
    for c in claims:
        if llm is None and all(ch.passed for ch in c.checks):
            c.checks.append(Check(name="semantic", passed=False, detail="Semantic check needs the verifier model."))
        c.status = "verified" if all(ch.passed for ch in c.checks) else "removed"
    return claims
"""Agent 1 - Retriever: free-text idea -> validated IdeaSpec grounded in the knowledge graph.

Candidates are found by code only:
    - feature names, aliases and fuzzy names, plus the trained feature classifier
      (DecisionEngine.resolve_idea - the same matching the decision engine uses);
    - the semantic index over the features' graph neighbourhoods.
The LLM (OPENAI_RETRIEVER_MODEL) only chooses among those candidates and reads
the scope (series, markets, move, price) out of the text. Its answer is
validated by IdeaSpec with the candidate names as context; a rejected answer is
sent back with the validation errors, up to MAX_ATTEMPTS times. Without an API
key, or if every attempt fails validation, transparent rules are used and the
result says so.
"""

import re

from pydantic import ValidationError

from .contracts import MAX_FEATURES, Candidate, FeaturePick, IdeaSpec, IdeaSpecLLM, InterpretResult
from .llm import LLMError, LLMOutputInvalid

MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3
MAX_CANDIDATES = 12

INSTRUCTIONS = """You are the retrieval agent of BMW's product-idea evaluator for product managers.
You map the PM's idea onto features that exist in BMW's customer-feedback knowledge graph and read the scope of the idea.

Rules:
- features: choose ONLY from the CANDIDATES list and copy the names exactly. Pick the features the idea is actually about (at most 3), most relevant first. If no candidate is about the same thing, return an empty list.
- novelty: 'matches_existing' if you chose features that are the idea's subject; 'related_only' if you chose features that are only adjacent to the idea; 'new_to_data' if you chose none.
- series: F70 = 1 Series, G60 = 5 Series, G70 = 7 Series. List only series the idea names; empty list if it names none.
- markets: EU = Europe (Germany, UK, France, the Nordics, ...), US = United States, CN = China, RoW = rest of world (Japan, Korea, Australia, Canada, South Africa, ...). Only markets the idea names; empty list if none.
- move: fix_existing (fix or improve something customers already have), make_standard (make it standard equipment), new_option (offer it as an option), price_change (change its price), introduce_on_series (bring it to a series that lacks it), unspecified.
- proposed_price_eur: only a price in euros that the idea states; otherwise null. Do not convert currencies.
- summary: one sentence restating the idea for a PM. Add nothing the idea does not say.
- ambiguities: short notes on what the PM should confirm (e.g. 'No series named; all three will be evaluated')."""


class Retriever:
    def __init__(self, engine, graph, index):
        self.engine, self.g, self.index = engine, graph, index

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ candidates (code only)
    def candidates(self, idea: str, llm=None) -> tuple[list[Candidate], str, str | None, dict]:
        res = self.engine.resolve_idea(idea)
        found: dict[str, dict] = {}
        for m in res["matches"]:
            key = "classifier" if m["how"] == "text classifier" else "name_or_alias"
            entry = found.setdefault(m["feature"], {"methods": {}, "how": []})
            entry["methods"][key] = max(entry["methods"].get(key, 0.0), round(float(m["score"]), 4))
            entry["how"].append(f"{m['how']} {m['score']:.2f}")
        sem_error = None
        embed, model = None, None
        if llm is not None:
            embed, model = llm.embed, llm.models["embedding"]
        try:
            sem = self.index.search(idea, k=8, embed=embed, model=model)
        except LLMError as e:
            sem_error = f"Embeddings failed ({e}); fell back to TF-IDF."
            sem = self.index.search(idea, k=8)
        for f, s in sem["results"]:
            entry = found.setdefault(f, {"methods": {}, "how": []})
            entry["methods"]["semantic"] = s
            entry["how"].append(f"semantic {s:.2f}")
        feats = self.engine.ctx.features
        out = []
        for f, e in found.items():
            if f not in feats.index:
                continue
            row = feats.loc[f]
            out.append(Candidate(feature=f, node_id=f"feature:{f}", domain=row["domain"], verdict=row["verdict"],
                                 n_comments=int(row["n_comments"]), umbrella=bool(row["is_umbrella"]),
                                 methods=e["methods"], how=e["how"]))
        out.sort(key=lambda c: (-c.methods.get("name_or_alias", 0), -c.methods.get("classifier", 0),
                                -c.methods.get("semantic", 0)))
        return out[:MAX_CANDIDATES], sem["method"], sem_error, res

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ interpret
    def interpret(self, idea: str, llm=None) -> InterpretResult:
        idea = idea.strip()
        cands, sem_method, sem_error, resolution = self.candidates(idea, llm)
        by_name = {c.feature: c for c in cands}
        attempts = []
        if llm is not None:
            prompt = _prompt(idea, cands)
            for i in range(1, MAX_ATTEMPTS + 1):
                try:
                    draft = llm.parse("retriever", INSTRUCTIONS, prompt, IdeaSpecLLM)
                    spec = _to_spec(idea, draft, by_name, f"llm:{llm.models['retriever']}")
                    attempts.append({"attempt": i, "ok": True, "errors": []})
                    return InterpretResult(spec=spec, candidates=cands, semantic_method=sem_method,
                                           semantic_error=sem_error, method=spec.method, attempts=attempts)
                except (ValidationError, LLMOutputInvalid) as e:
                    errors = (e.errors if isinstance(e, LLMOutputInvalid) else
                              [f"{'.'.join(str(x) for x in err['loc']) or 'spec'}: {err['msg']}" for err in e.errors()])
                    attempts.append({"attempt": i, "ok": False, "errors": errors})
                    prompt = (_prompt(idea, cands) + "\n\nYour previous answer was rejected by validation:\n- "
                              + "\n- ".join(errors) + "\nFix these problems and answer again.")
                except LLMError as e:
                    attempts.append({"attempt": i, "ok": False, "errors": [str(e)]})
                    break
        spec = rules_spec(idea, resolution, by_name)
        if attempts:
            spec.method = "rules (the LLM answer was not usable; see attempts)"
        return InterpretResult(spec=spec, candidates=cands, semantic_method=sem_method, semantic_error=sem_error,
                               method=spec.method, attempts=attempts)


def _prompt(idea: str, cands: list[Candidate]) -> str:
    lines = [f"IDEA: {idea}", "", "CANDIDATES (feature | domain | verdict | comments | how it was found):"]
    for c in cands:
        lines.append(f"- {c.feature} | {c.domain} | '{c.verdict}' | {c.n_comments} comments | {', '.join(c.how)}"
                     + (" | umbrella label (general praise is filed here)" if c.umbrella else ""))
    if not cands:
        lines.append("(none)")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def _to_spec(idea: str, d: IdeaSpecLLM, by_name: dict, method: str) -> IdeaSpec:
    """Validate the LLM's draft against the candidates (raises pydantic.ValidationError)."""
    picks = [{"feature": p.feature, "node_id": f"feature:{p.feature}", "reason": p.reason,
              "methods": by_name[p.feature].methods if p.feature in by_name else {}} for p in d.features]
    data = {"idea": idea, "summary": d.summary, "features": picks, "series": d.series, "markets": d.markets,
            "move": d.move, "proposed_price_eur": d.proposed_price_eur, "novelty": d.novelty,
            "ambiguities": d.ambiguities, "method": method}
    return IdeaSpec.model_validate(data, context={"allowed_features": set(by_name)})


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------- rules (no LLM)
SERIES_PATTERNS = {
    "F70": r"\b(f70|1\s?series|1er|1-series|one series)\b",
    "G60": r"\b(g60|5\s?series|5er|5-series|five series|i5)\b",
    "G70": r"\b(g70|7\s?series|7er|7-series|seven series|i7)\b",
}
MARKET_RULES = {   # (pattern, flags): country words case-insensitive, codes case-sensitive ("us" is a pronoun)
    "EU": [(r"\b(europe|european|germany|german|uk|united kingdom|britain|british|france|french|spain|sweden|"
            r"norway|denmark|finland|italy|latvia)\b", re.I), (r"\bEU\b", 0)],
    "US": [(r"\b(united states|america|american)\b", re.I), (r"\b(US|USA)\b|\bU\.S\.", 0)],
    "CN": [(r"\b(china|chinese)\b", re.I), (r"\bCN\b", 0)],
    "RoW": [(r"\b(rest of (the )?world|japan|korea|australia|canada|south africa)\b", re.I), (r"\bRoW\b", 0)],
}
MOVE_PATTERNS = [
    ("price_change", r"\b(cheaper|pric(?:e|ed|es|ing)|discount\w*|cost less|lower the cost|more expensive)\b"),
    ("make_standard", r"\b(standard|as standard|standard equipment|fit as standard|make it standard)\b"),
    ("fix_existing", r"\b(fix|improve|repair|defect|bug|issue|problem|complain\w*|overheat\w*|broken|fail\w*|"
                     r"unreliable|annoying|hard to use|confusing)\b"),
    ("new_option", r"\b(option|optional|add-on|package)\b"),
    ("introduce_on_series", r"\b(introduce|bring|roll out|launch)\b"),
]
PRICE_RE = re.compile(r"(?:€|\beur\b|\beuros?\b)\s?(\d{1,3}(?:[.,]\d{3})+|\d+)|(\d{1,3}(?:[.,]\d{3})+|\d+)\s?"
                      r"(?:€|\beur\b|\beuros?\b)", re.I)


def rules_spec(idea: str, resolution: dict, by_name: dict) -> IdeaSpec:
    low = idea.lower()
    series = [s for s, p in SERIES_PATTERNS.items() if re.search(p, low)]
    markets = [m for m, rules in MARKET_RULES.items() if any(re.search(p, idea, fl) for p, fl in rules)]
    move = next((mv for mv, p in MOVE_PATTERNS if re.search(p, low)), "unspecified")
    price = None
    pm = PRICE_RE.search(idea)
    if pm:
        raw = (pm.group(1) or pm.group(2)).replace(".", "").replace(",", "")
        price = float(raw) if raw.isdigit() and 0 < float(raw) < 1_000_000 else None
    chosen = [f for f in resolution.get("suggested", []) if f in by_name][:MAX_FEATURES]
    picks = [FeaturePick(feature=f, node_id=f"feature:{f}", reason="matched by name, alias or the feature classifier "
                         "with score >= 0.5", methods=by_name[f].methods) for f in chosen]
    novelty = "matches_existing" if picks else ("related_only" if resolution.get("status") == "related"
                                                else "new_to_data")
    amb = []
    if not series:
        amb.append("No series named; all three series are evaluated.")
    if not markets:
        amb.append("No market named; all four markets are evaluated.")
    if not picks:
        amb.append("No feature matched with a score of 0.5 or more; pick a related feature or treat the idea as new.")
    return IdeaSpec(idea=idea, summary=idea, features=picks, series=series, markets=markets, move=move,
                    proposed_price_eur=price, novelty=novelty, ambiguities=amb, method="rules")
